meta.title: Invalid schedule for the auction
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the stated bids.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the conversion flow.
Move to the closed RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Start the RFQ-to-Auction conversion and continue through the conversion prompt.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, choose a schedule whose start is before the original RFQ ended, press Publish, and stop when Procol shows the invalid schedule refusal.

steps.note: No catalog domain step can select this absolute invalid converted-auction schedule and attempt publication.
Assert that publication was refused with the expected schedule validation message.
